tariff_note: Census records actual _flops_used deltas and charge-site dtypes. Installed resolve_billing_dtype uses result_type over these declared participants, including out/dtype. Every observed signature containing float64 is real-only and therefore resolves float64 at rate2. Tagging identifies resolved rate here, not which operand was responsible or the allocation/element shape of pointwise operations. Mixed FP32/F64 and out=F64 remain rate2; casts also include wider source/destination.
